common.loadError: We couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.subtitle: Sign in with your Oxy account to bring your profile, the people you follow and your posts with you.

home.title: Bring your digital life to Oxy
home.subtitle: Connect the account you're leaving. Move brings your profile and the people you follow to Oxy, and your posts to Mention.

connect.title: Connect {{name}}
connect.unknownBody: Go back and pick one of the platforms Move supports.

intro.mastodon: Sign in to your Mastodon server once, so Oxy knows the account is yours. Move never keeps access to it.
intro.bluesky: Sign in to Bluesky once, so Oxy knows the account is yours. Move never keeps access to it.

connect.unlinkBody: Oxy will stop treating this account as yours. Anything you already moved stays.

inputHint.mastodon: Your full handle (@you@mastodon.social) or just the server (mastodon.social).
inputHint.bluesky: Your handle, like you.bsky.social, or your own domain.

inputInvalid.mastodon: That doesn't look like a Mastodon handle or server.
inputInvalid.bluesky: That doesn't look like a Bluesky handle.

startFailed.instance_invalid: That doesn't look like a Mastodon server. Check the address and try again.
startFailed.instance_unreachable: We couldn't reach that Mastodon server. Check the address and try again.
startFailed.handle_unresolvable: We couldn't find that Bluesky account. Check the handle and try again.

provider_rejected.mastodon: That server didn't accept a connection from Oxy. Is it a Mastodon-compatible server?
provider_rejected.bluesky: Bluesky didn't accept the connection from Oxy. Your handle is fine; this is on our side, so please try again later.

startFailed.provider_unavailable: {{name}} isn't responding right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
startFailed.unknown: We couldn't start connecting to {{name}}. Please try again.

connect.privacy: You'll sign in on {{name}}'s own page. Oxy only learns which account it is, then discards the access.

linkErrors.access_denied: You cancelled the sign-in. Nothing was connected.
linkErrors.already_linked: That account is already connected to another Oxy account.
linkErrors.expired_or_foreign: That link has expired or was started from another Oxy account. Please start again.
linkErrors.verification_failed: We couldn't verify that account. Please try again.
linkErrors.provider_unavailable: That server couldn't be reached right now. Please try again later.
linkErrors.unknown: Connecting didn't finish. Please try again.

linked.title: Connect account
linked.successBody: {{handle}} is now connected to your Oxy account.
linked.successBodyGeneric: Your account is now connected to Oxy.
linked.signInToContinue: Sign in with the Oxy account you started from to finish connecting.
linked.nothingBody: This page finishes connecting an account. Start from the home screen.

confirm.title: Review your move
confirm.profileHint: Name, bio, picture and links, onto your Oxy profile.
confirm.postsHint: Imported to Mention with their original dates.
confirm.dateRange: From {{oldest}} to {{newest}}, onto Mention with their original dates.
confirm.followingHidden: The accounts you follow are hidden
confirm.followingHint: Everyone who is also on Oxy is followed for you.
confirm.followersHint: After your posts arrive, one step on Mastodon sends your followers to your new account.
confirm.includeBoostsHint: Bring the posts you boosted, as links to the originals.
confirm.includeRepliesHint: Your own threads always come along.
confirm.undoNote: You can undo the whole move later from your history.
confirm.blocksHint: Everyone you block on Bluesky who is also on Oxy is blocked for you.

jobErrors.linked_account_not_owned: That account isn't connected to your Oxy account anymore. Connect it again.
jobErrors.source_requires_authorized_fetch: Your server doesn't share posts with Oxy. It may block oxy.so or only talk to servers it has approved; its admins can change that.
jobErrors.source_unavailable: Your account's server isn't responding right now. Please try again later.
jobErrors.active_job_exists: You already have a move from this account in progress. Open it from your history.

progress.title: Moving
progress.queued: Your move is queued and will start in a moment.
progress.paused: Paused to respect rate limits. It continues on its own around {{until}}.
progress.done: Everything is here. Welcome to Oxy!
progress.applyFailed: We couldn't finish updating your Oxy account. Your progress is saved.
progress.cancelBody: What already arrived stays. You can undo it from your history.

mastodonMove.title: Bring your followers
mastodonMove.notYet: Once your posts are in, one step on Mastodon sends your followers to your new account.
mastodonMove.body: Your posts are in. Now tell Mastodon you moved, and your followers will follow your new account.
mastodonMove.steps: Open Mastodon → Settings → Account → Move to a different account, and enter this handle:

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: When you move an account, it shows up here, and you can undo it.
history.undoBody: The imported posts are deleted from Mention, the people Move followed or blocked for you are unfollowed or unblocked, and your profile goes back to how it was.
history.undone: Move undone: {{posts}} posts removed, {{follows}} unfollowed, {{blocks}} unblocked.
history.undoPartial_one: {{count}} post couldn't be removed yet. Try undoing again.
history.undoPartial_other: {{count}} posts couldn't be removed yet. Try undoing again.
history.undoKept: Your profile was changed by an older version of Move without a record of how it was, so it was left as it is.
history.undoFailed: We couldn't undo this move. Please try again.
